description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [100% Critical], [Awoken Ninja], [Damage Cap +10000], [Chain Materia Mode II (Earth, Water)], [Ninja Spirit], [Physical Blink Stacking 2] and [Physical Blink 2] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ninja
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Chain Materia Mode II (Earth, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Earth/Water ability

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Ninja Spirit
description.text: Grants [Ninja +30% Boost 3] to the user after using a Ninja ability, removed after triggering

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2

description.name: Physical Blink 2
description.text: Evades the next 2 PHY attacks that deal physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attacks that deal physical or fractional damage
